notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable tabulations, no RESULT lines). Final: pooled OLS LPMs with fixest::feols, school-clustered SEs (30 clusters), on master.dta. Punishment models on the Violation + Violation+Help scenes (scene 2,3), Helping models on Help + Violation+Help scenes (scene 1,3); RHS Child, VH (scene==3, equal to ViolationHelp), Child x VH; controls male (Male Target), hugo (Male Actor), Morning, witness, rich, Rain, Hot. Outcome for helping is Helping (counts parent-stimulated child help, as in the paper's definition), not HelpingParents (the robustness variant). One observation dropped in controlled models for missing male. No author scripts, result tables, or tex/pdf files from the dataset directory were opened.
